notes: Web 395 — NAV-LINK-NO-ROUTE-NOV10 (owner Nov 10, 2026 ~08:47 CST, screen clip + his 'Yes' to the read-back: the dump site's Google Maps link — https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=51.1225089,-114.0122197 — pasted into the Navigator's SEARCH BOX, Go tapped; the map stood on 'You are here', no pin, no route). CONVICTED by tools/navlink-searchbox-v395-test.js (failing-first on shipped 394 bytes: 12 passed / 19 failed there, 31/31 here): the search brain (searchBtn.onclick — the one handler the sheet Search, the map-face Go and 'Search as address' all run) had NO pin step: saved places, then the raw text went to the Nominatim geocoder, which returns nothing for a link; the v183 retry re-searched the text after the link's first comma (the coordinate pair's own tail), failed again, and wrote 'No places found' into #nv_results inside the FOLDED sheet, where the driver never sees it. The paste bar (openSentPin) read the same link fine — the two doors disagreed about what a link is. Every coordinate-carrying shape failed in the search box: maps/search api=1, maps/dir api=1, maps.app.goo.gl short links, bare 'lat, lng', and a whole dispatch message carrying a full link. THE FIX (modules/navigator.js, searchBtn.onclick only; the shipped file is built on the LIVE web-390 navigator bytes — webs 391-394 never touched this file — plus this hunk): the pin step now stands at the head of the search, before saved places and before the geocoder, on the paste bar's own roads: (1) a pin INSIDE the text (sentPinCoords: an api=1/@/dir pair, a %2C pair, a !3d/!4d segment, bare coordinates, a full link inside a message) lands at once through landSentPin — setDest + setView + recordVisit, the route auto-firing from setDest, the same end state as a manual pin drop; (2) a link that HIDES its pin (a short link, or a bare Maps URL the local read cannot open) is followed through the ONE link brain (PinLinks.resolveUrl — the direct follow, then the /ai/resolve server door) and lands the same way; (3) a link that yields nothing gets the paste bar's plain words in the results box — never a silent dead end, and the geocoder is never fed a link again. Typed place search, saved-place wins, pin drop and the paste bar are untouched. PROOF: new suite 31/31; the navigator family is identical to the pristine-live baseline (v330 28/2, pindrop-panel 25/0, 2step-v209 23/2, batch-v183 36/1, corners-v343 38/3, bottom-stack-v348 59/3, dispatch-navpin 47/49, crosscopy-v329 24/0, glance-v244 12/0, screen 38/2 — pre-existing frozen-fixture standings, unchanged). The identical hunk is mirrored in the main dev tree's uncommitted modules/navigator.js so a future harvest cannot regress it (its v368 bench standing is unchanged, 60/13 with and without the hunk). No Job A code is in this release; no other module changes. index.html pins modules/navigator.js 387 -> 395 only. Native pointer preserved: version 73, apkUrl meticulous-v73.apk; webVersion 394 -> 395; files map updated for modules/navigator.js + index.html only.
